record.bible_text: Wherefore<WH0199>, Job<WH0347>, I pray thee, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> my speeches<WH04405>, and hearken<WH0238><WTH8685> to all my words<WH01697>.
Behold, now I have opened<WH06605><WTH8804> my mouth<WH06310>, my tongue<WH03956> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> in my mouth<WH02441>. <RF>in my mouth: Heb. in my palate<Rf>
My words<WH0561> <FI>shall be of<Fi> the uprightness<WH03476> of my heart<WH03820>: and my lips<WH08193> shall utter<WH04448><WTH8765> knowledge<WH01847> clearly<WH01305><WTH8803>.
The Spirit<WH07307> of God<WH0410> hath made<WH06213><WTH8804> me, and the breath<WH05397> of the Almighty<WH07706> hath given me life<WH02421><WTH8762>.
If thou canst<WH03201><WTH8799> answer<WH07725><WTH8687> me, set <FI>thy words<Fi> in order<WH06186><WTH8798> before<WH06440> me, stand up<WH03320><WTH8690>.
Behold, I <FI>am<Fi> according to thy wish<WH06310> in God's<WH0410> stead: I also am formed<WH07169><WTH8795> out of the clay<WH02563>. <RF>wish: Heb. mouth<Rf> <RF>formed: Heb. cut<Rf>
Behold, my terror<WH0367> shall not make thee afraid<WH01204><WTH8762>, neither shall my hand<WH0405> be heavy<WH03513><WTH8799> upon thee.<CM>
Surely thou hast spoken<WH0559><WTH8804> in mine hearing<WH0241>, and I have heard<WH08085><WTH8799> the voice<WH06963> of <FI>thy<Fi> words<WH04405>, <FI>saying<Fi> , <RF>hearing: Heb. ears<Rf>
I am clean<WH02134> without transgression<WH06588>, I <FI>am<Fi> innocent<WH02643>; neither <FI>is there<Fi> iniquity<WH05771> in me.
Behold, he findeth<WH04672><WTH8799> occasions<WH08569> against me, he counteth<WH02803><WTH8799> me for his enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>,
He putteth<WH07760><WTH8799> my feet<WH07272> in the stocks<WH05465>, he marketh<WH08104><WTH8799> all my paths<WH0734>.
Behold, <FI>in<Fi> this thou art not just<WH06663><WTH8804>: I will answer<WH06030><WTH8799> thee, that God<WH0433> is greater<WH07235><WTH8799> than man<WH0582>.
Why dost thou strive<WH07378><WTH8804> against him? for he giveth not account<WH06030><WTH8799> of any of his matters<WH01697>. <RF>he giveth...: Heb. he answereth not<Rf><CM>
For God<WH0410> speaketh<WH01696><WTH8762> once<WH0259>, yea twice<WH08147>, <FI>yet man<Fi> perceiveth<WH07789><WTH8799> it not.
In a dream<WH02472>, in a vision<WH02384> of the night<WH03915>, when deep<WH08639> sleep falleth<WH05307><WTH8800> upon men<WH0582>, in slumberings<WH08572> upon the bed<WH04904>;
Then he openeth<WH01540><WTH8799> the ears<WH0241> of men<WH0582>, and sealeth<WH02856><WTH8799> their instruction<WH04561>, <RF>he...: Heb. he revealeth, or, uncovereth<Rf>
That he may withdraw<WH05493><WTH8687> man<WH0120> <FI>from his<Fi> purpose<WH04639>, and hide<WH03680><WTH8762> pride<WH01466> from man<WH01397>. <RF>purpose: Heb. work<Rf>
He keepeth back<WH02820><WTH8799> his soul<WH05315> from the pit<WH07845>, and his life<WH02416> from perishing<WH05674><WTH8800> by the sword<WH07973>. <RF>from perishing: Heb. from passing<Rf><CM>
He is chastened<WH03198><WTH8717> also with pain<WH04341> upon his bed<WH04904>, and the multitude<WH07230><WTH8675><WH07379> of his bones<WH06106> with strong<WH0386> <FI>pain<Fi> :
So that his life<WH02416> abhorreth<WH02092><WTH8765> bread<WH03899>, and his soul<WH05315> dainty<WH08378> meat<WH03978>. <RF>dainty...: Heb. meat of desire<Rf>

His flesh<WH01320> is consumed away<WH03615><WTH8799>, that it cannot be seen<WH07210>; and his bones<WH06106> <FI>that<Fi> were not seen<WH07200><WTH8795> stick out<WH08192><WTH8795><WTH8675><WH08205>.
Yea, his soul<WH05315> draweth near<WH07126><WTH8799> unto the grave<WH07845>, and his life<WH02416> to the destroyers<WH04191><WTH8688>.
If there<WH03426> be a messenger<WH04397> with him, an interpreter<WH03887><WTH8688>, one<WH0259> among a thousand<WH0505>, to shew<WH05046><WTH8687> unto man<WH0120> his uprightness<WH03476>:

Then he is gracious<WH02603><WTH8799> unto him, and saith<WH0559><WTH8799>, Deliver<WH06308><WTH8798> him from going down<WH03381><WTH8800> to the pit<WH07845>: I have found<WH04672><WTH8804> a ransom<WH03724>. <RF>a ransom: or, an atonement<Rf>
His flesh<WH01320> shall be fresher<WH07375><WTH8738> than a child's<WH05290>: he shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> to the days<WH03117> of his youth<WH05934>: <RF>a child's: Heb. childhood<Rf>

He shall pray<WH06279><WTH8799> unto God<WH0433>, and he will be favourable<WH07521><WTH8799> unto him: and he shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> his face<WH06440> with joy<WH08643>: for he will render<WH07725><WTH8686> unto man<WH0582> his righteousness<WH06666>.

He looketh<WH07789><WTH8799> upon men<WH0582>, and <FI>if any<Fi> say<WH0559><WTH8799>, I have sinned<WH02398><WTH8804>, and perverted<WH05753><WTH8689> <FI>that which was<Fi> right<WH03477>, and it profited<WH07737><WTH8804> me not; <RF>He...: or, He shall look upon men, and say<Rf>

He will deliver<WH06299><WTH8804> his soul<WH05315> from going<WH05674><WTH8800> into the pit<WH07845>, and his life<WH02416> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> the light<WH0216>. <RF>He...: or, He hath delivered my soul, etc, and my life<Rf><CM>
Lo, all these <FI>things<Fi> worketh<WH06466><WTH8799> God<WH0410> oftentimes<WH06471><WH07969> with man<WH01397>, <RF>oftentimes: Heb. twice and thrice<Rf>
To bring back<WH07725><WTH8687> his soul<WH05315> from the pit<WH07845>, to be enlightened<WH0215><WTH8736> with the light<WH0216> of the living<WH02416>.
Mark well<WH07181><WTH8685>, O Job<WH0347>, hearken<WH08085><WTH8798> unto me: hold thy peace<WH02790><WTH8685>, and I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762>.
If thou hast<WH03426> any thing to say<WH04405>, answer<WH07725><WTH8685> me: speak<WH01696><WTH8761>, for I desire<WH02654><WTH8804> to justify<WH06663><WTH8763> thee.
If not, hearken<WH08085><WTH8798> unto me: hold thy peace<WH02790><WTH8685>, and I shall teach<WH0502><WTH8762> thee wisdom<WH02451>.<CM>
